description: PAID (0.25 USDC on Base via x402). Technical deep audit as JSON: TLS certificate (issuer, expiry, SAN, protocol), the seven security headers, cookie flags, DNS and email security (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, CAA, MX), compression and caching, and AI-agent readiness (robots.txt, llms.txt, security.txt, blocked AI crawlers). Every finding is ranked critical/high/medium/low with a copy-paste fix, plus a prioritised remediation plan. Also returns report_url with a human-readable HTML report.
